sloka: कथयित्वा सुदुह्ख आर्तः सुमन्त्रेण चिरम् सह ।रामे दक्षिण कूलस्थे जगाम स्व गृहम् गुहः ॥२-५७-१॥
transliteration: kathayitvā suduhkha ārtaḥ sumantreṇa ciram saha ।rāme dakṣiṇa kūlasthe jagāma sva gṛham guhaḥ ॥2-57-1॥

translations.english: Until Rama reached the southern bank, Guha kept talking with Sumantra for long and returned home with great sorrow.
